name: verify_customer
description: Verify the caller's identity with the orderer's name and mobile phone number. Required before any order lookup, cancellation or return.

phone.description: Mobile number as digits only, e.g. 01012345678

name: list_orders
description: List recent orders of a verified customer.

name: get_order
description: Get order details: status, items, shipping carrier and tracking number, delivery date.

name: cancel_order
description: Cancel an order. Only for status 결제완료 or 상품준비중, and only after the caller explicitly agreed.

reason.description: Short reason given by the caller

name: request_return
description: Register a return. Only within 7 days after delivery, unopened items, after the caller agreed.

name: get_product_info
description: Get product facts: ingredients, how to take it, price, stock.

name: transfer_to_agent
description: Hand the call over to a human agent.

summary.description: One-sentence summary of the call so far

preferred_time.description: Preferred time as the caller said it, e.g. 내일 오전
